receive_and_metadata.assessment: Current source has typed EntityKind storage and per-entity metadata handling for supported kinds; examples include ZombieVillager conversion metadata. The report confirms target existence/position server-side, but does not prove that each target type and its wire metadata reach this store correctly. For a target whose kind is received but has no renderer entry, metadata cannot supply missing geometry or texture. No receive-path failure was demonstrated for the 26 records. Zombie villager candidate must be investigated independently: renderer already defines ZombieVillager and profession/type overlays, so its candidate is not explained by missing MobDef.

model_texture_and_draw.finding: mob_definitions() registers only a limited subset (including Arrow, common farm mobs, ZombieVillager, Skeleton/Stray/Bogged, etc.). None of the 26 confirmed record kinds is registered as a MobDef in the inspected current source; the model bake functions were likewise not found for the target models. The renderer builds the mobs HashMap only from those definitions. In draw, missing self.mobs.get(&info.entity_kind) takes continue, producing neither model nor texture draw. Thus the directly evidenced implementation gap is renderer model/texture registration (including model bake/variant/texture and per-kind animation as applicable), not a shared Vulkan failure. Texture-only additions cannot fix it.

candidate_zombie_villager.finding: ZombieVillager is registered with bake_zombie_villager_model and base texture, plus villager_like_overlays for type/profession/level and baby overlays. Existing metadata store handles relevant curing flag, but the candidate is hat/profession apparel, so compare actual received villager type/profession/level/hats metadata and overlay gating/index selection against a fixed-state reference. Do not mark this as a bug or resolved absent further controlled evidence.

minimal_fix_proposal_not_applied: For each confirmed missing entity type, add the smallest correct baked model and MobDef entry in entity_renderer.rs using existing model/texture/variant abstractions where geometrically appropriate. Add type-specific metadata decoding only where protocol/vanilla state requires variants or layers; do not invent metadata fixes before packet values are traced.
Preserve already working shared rendering. Do not edit shared renderer in this audit; no source change was made.

For equipment/variant overlays, implement only the layer required by the tested state; avoid a broad all-entity rendering rewrite. Minecart carried block/TNT, boat chest, thrown projectiles, undead/equipment variants need their actual distinct geometry/layers, not unrelated placeholder reuse.

EntityStore tests feed protocol-specific spawn and metadata values for each supported state (e.g. age, variant, equipment, charged/puff/conversion flags as applicable), assert stored EntityKind and decoded fields; use captured server wire packets rather than assumed indices.

Include separate tests for boat/chest boat, minecart/TNT payload, potion/fireball/trident orientation, baby/adult and equipment layers where relevant.
